narrative: Material PL1__M375AD40 exhibits smooth, high-volume daily demand (mean 943.6 units/day, CV=0.38) with no statistically significant trend over the observed period. Lead times are highly variable (CV=0.42, mean 2.71 days), and this variability dominates 77% of the total demand-during-lead-time uncertainty, driving a recommended safety stock of 2,021 units. The current SAP policy of zero safety stock is critically insufficient for the 95% service level target. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with reorder point 4,577 and order quantity 5,883 (EOQ-derived, MOQ=643 satisfied, capacity constraint 17,466 respected) is recommended.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth, high-volume demand with no trend makes a continuous-review (r,Q) model optimal. The EOQ formula provides an economically efficient order quantity, while the reorder point with safety stock buffers the dominant lead-time variability. The MOQ of 643 units is comfortably below the EOQ of 4,819, so no MOQ conflict exists.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity constraint of 17,466 units is not binding: SS(2021) + OQ(5883) = 7,904, well within limit. If demand shifts upward or safety stock is increased, the 17,466 cap should be monitored.
